pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Rochester GPA
helpIntro: The University of Rochester College undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale weighted by credit hours. Enter Rochester letter grades and credits to estimate current, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: Use this profile for College undergraduate work in Arts & Sciences, Hajim, and undergraduate Simon courses. Hajim does not assign D+ or D-. External transfer grades are excluded. SAS/Hajim graduate programs do not issue an official GPA. Repeat Impact applies only to eligible current-policy Rochester repeats.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.0 grade points and a 4-credit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 29.2 ÷ 8 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.E: Failure; credit hours count in GPA at 0.0 points.
gradeExplanations.XE: Failure for academic dishonesty; credit hours count in GPA at 0.0 points.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass under a mandatory pass/fail system; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory under the S/F option; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.F: Failure under S/F or pass/fail; excluded from the cumulative average.
gradeExplanations.XF: Failure for academic dishonesty in an S/F course; no grade points in the undergraduate cumulative average.
gradeExplanations.N: No grade reported; unresolved and excluded pending a final grade.
gradeExplanations.CR: Credit notation; excluded from cumulative GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: No-credit notation; excluded from cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: Arts & Sciences / undergraduate Simon course
specialTypes.note: Use the standard undergraduate 4.0 grading scheme.

specialTypes.name: Hajim course
specialTypes.note: Hajim uses the same points but does not assign D+ or D-.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or area-college course
specialTypes.note: External grades do not enter the Rochester GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible repeat, the second Rochester grade replaces the first in the GPA even if it is lower; both attempts remain on the transcript and credit is earned once.
